_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,534 stores in 50 states and Canada with 174 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.00x; -22% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.10; conservative 2yr +54%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.5%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-21.7%/yr (Q2 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.0%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2008-07-25) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.00x (-0.1% downside to Bear $20 / +180.3% upside to Bull $56) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.75: gap -0.10 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -22% above the EPP floor $26 (17x FY08E $1.50) | Conservative 2-yr case: +53.7% total (+26.8%/yr) | At 13.3x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $26 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -8.4% in Q1 FY08, forward sales +1% (Q2 FY08 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
